scope: Read-only local inspection of every tracked .github/workflows file on exact PR29 and exact main. No workflow, tests, history lookup or remote action executed.

workflows.name: Check preferred-date alerts
workflows.trigger_source:
workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tests_only:
        description: Send requested phone tests without scanning courses
        type: boolean
        default: false
workflows.effect_if_authorized_dispatch_occurs: Extracts .github/alerts-runtime.zip, authenticates, executes service.push_worker (or tests-only notification path). Not invoked in this audit.
workflows.hash_basis: Exact git blob bytes, preserving CRLF where present

workflows.name: Refresh official course news
workflows.trigger_source:
push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/course-news.yml'
      - 'scripts/collect_course_news.py'
      - 'data/course_news_sources.json'
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 21 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
events: push with branch main and three explicit paths
workflows.effect_if_eligible_event_occurs: Collects official announcements and invokes scripts/publish_course_news.py.
workflows.hash_basis: Exact git blob bytes, preserving CRLF where present

workflows.name: Refresh four-week tee-time cache
workflows.trigger_source:
workflow_dispatch:
  # Reuse the existing external ten-minute heartbeat, even if the alert check
  # fails. This does not dispatch the checker or change notification behavior.
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Check preferred-date alerts"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/refresh-cache-10min.yml"
      - "scripts/**"
  schedule:
    # Best-effort fallback if the external heartbeat stops.
    - cron: "7,17,27,37,47,57 * * * *"
workflows.classification: production provider/weather refresh and cache publication
events: push with branch main and refresh-workflow/scripts paths
workflow_run completed Check preferred-date alerts on main

workflows.effect_if_eligible_event_occurs: Calls weather preparation, provider shard refresh, cache index validation and force-pushes orphan cache branch.
